equations.kinetics: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + Du lap u; dv/dt = b - u^2 v + Dv lap v
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)); tr = f_u + g_v - k^2 (Du + Dv); det = (f_u g_v - f_v g_u) - k^2 (Dv f_u + Du g_v) + Du Dv k^4
equations.selected_wavenumber: k_c = argmax sigma(k); lambda = 2 pi / k_c
